record.paper: Catching a robber on a random $k$-uniform hypergraph

dossier_meta.paper: Catching a robber on a random $k$-uniform hypergraph
dossier_meta.statement_text: Let $H$ be a connected $k$-graph on $n$ vertices. Then $c(H) = O\!\left(\sqrt{\dfrac{n}{k}}\right)$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors introduce this as a generalisation of Meyniel's conjecture to $k$-uniform hypergraphs, motivated by a blow-up construction that shows $c(H) = \Omega\!\left(\sqrt{n/k}\right)$ is achievable. They further observe that for any polynomial $k = n^\alpha$ with $\alpha < 1$, Conjecture 1.4 implies Meyniel's conjecture.
